ci-bot: PR #21456 — microbench_kernel_select FAILED: latency +12% (threshold +5%). artifact: https://ci.internal/runs/21456/artifacts
jamie: saw this, looks tied to the 'kernel-autoselect: hotload table' merge from yesterday 9f3a (9f3a8b2).
maria: pulling artifacts now. quick numbers:
95th: main=28.0ms -> pr=31.4ms
kv_hit: 0.82 -> 0.54
batch_wait_ms: 1.2 -> 3.8
ash: ack. can we bisect? which commits in that merge?
simon: started bisect locally. early signal points to commit 9f3a8b2 'hotload kernel table v2' — reproduces on microbench with KV_WARMUP=0
maria: repro steps I ran:
```bash
export KV_WARMUP=0
./tools/microbench --bench=kernel_select --iters=500 --kernel=autoselect
```
output snippet:
```
[run] median=12.4ms p95=31.4ms kv_hit=0.54
```
jamie: ugh. that change altered kernel scoring fallback, looks like a bias toward larger kernels for short sequences. could explain kv cache miss surge.
ash: opening revert PR 21460, will run ci quickbench. if revert passes we can unblock release.
simon: alternative: pin kernel selector to legacy rule in runtime config for dedicated pools: `--kernel-selector=legacy-v1` until we fix scoring.
maria: added extra logging to selector (telemetry) in a debug branch: https://stash.internal/commits/selector-telemetry — will add more histograms for seq-len -> kernel-choice.
ci-bot: release v1.23: rollout-blocked set by eng-runtime due to perf regression :lock:
jamie: plan: ash to open revert, simon to add pin config change, maria to finish telemetry patch, i'll coordinate release hold. @ash @simon @maria :eyes:
ash: on it. running quick perf now, will post results.
ci-bot: quickbench run started: https://ci.internal/quick/21460
ash: quickbench shows p95 back to 28.2ms on revert branch. pushing revert PR now. :+1:
jamie: thanks all. leaving thread pinned until rollout cleared.
